snippet.title: ELMER – Surreal Metroidvania Adventure | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist Elmer on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3926650/Elmer/


Elmer is a hand-drawn 2D narrative adventure with Metroidvania elements, set in a world filled with strange places, eccentric characters, and hidden stories.

Explore AltroQuando, fight mysterious creatures, and meet unique inhabitants through dialogues, narrative events, and optional content.

During your journey you will:

• Explore interconnected areas and uncover hidden secrets
• Fight enemies and face mysterious situations
• Interact with eccentric characters through dialogues and narrative events
• Collect comics, zodiac signs, music albums, movie posters, and herbs
• Visit a cinema featuring multiple films to watch
• Attend concerts inside the town bar
• Discover the mysterious Pine Cones that mark the progression of the adventure
• Find optional content, environmental details, and side stories

Elmer is an experience focused on exploration, atmosphere, and discovering the world around you, combining narrative elements with Metroidvania-style progression.

Key Features:

• Hand-drawn 2D visuals
• Metroidvania-style exploration
• Narrative dialogue system
• Optional content and secret areas
• Numerous collectibles and side activities
• Original soundtrack
• Melancholic and surreal atmosphere

“AltroQuando is a place for those with a forgotten past.
Your presence here means you are searching for something… your mask.”

🌐 Official Website
https://elmerthegame.com/

🌐 Miòpe Games
https://www.miopegames.com/

#IndieGame #Metroidvania #AdventureGame
